snippet.title: BOBA:3 – Official Trailer | Cozy Merge Game | iOS Dec 3, Steam 2027
snippet.description:
two of the same animal make a bigger one. one of them farts. welcome to BOBA:3

BOBA:3 is a cozy merge game in a boba cup. drop little animals in, match two of the same, and grow them from a tiny mouse all the way to a whale. special friends mess with the cup: smelly farts on the neighbours, hungry eats the small ones, and a tiny bomb can save a cup that looked lost.
no energy, no wait timers, no pay-to-win. unlock 30+ flavors just by playing.
a tiny indie game made by one person.

pre-order on the app store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787864623
wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271920/BOBA3/
join the cup crew on discord: https://discord.gg/qPDNdqkfXR
website: https://play-boba.com

follow for updates :3
instagram: https://instagram.com/playboba3
tiktok: https://tiktok.com/@bobagame.3
x: https://x.com/shiloola

music: original score by Tomer Barnea

#cozygames #mergegame #indiegame
